User Story: As a patient, I want to find doctors by specialty so that I can choose a suitable doctor.
As a patient, I want to view available slots for a selected doctor so that I can choose a convenient time.
As a patient, I want to cancel a future appointment so that the slot becomes available to others.
As a patient, I want to reserve an available appointment slot so that I can receive a confirmed consultation.
As a patient, I want to move my appointment to another available slot so that I can attend at a suitable time.
As a doctor, I want to publish my available consultation slots so that patients can book only valid times.
As a patient, I want to receive a booking confirmation notification so that I have my appointment details.
As a patient, I want to receive a reminder 24 hours before my appointment so that I do not miss it.
As an authorized scheduler, I want to block an unbooked time slot so that it cannot be offered to patients.
As a doctor, I want to view my daily appointment list so that I can prepare for consultations.
As a patient, I want to view my appointment change history so that I can verify previous reschedules and cancellations.
As a patient, I want to enable or disable appointment reminders so that I control the notifications I receive.
